subject: Different linetype for horizontal lines in error bar

messages.author: ff1e723309cbc23e
messages.subject: Different linetype for horizontal lines in error bar
parts:
Dear all,

I was wondering if the following is doable with ggplot2: I have a line plot with error bars and would like to vary the linetype of all lines except the horizontal part of the error bars. Those lines are often too short for dashed lines which results in only one dash. I attached an example of the status quo and what I'd like to achieve.

Thanks,
Paul
